versions.subject: Windows Redcannary
versions.detection:
selection_curl:
  - Image|endswith: '\curl.exe'
  - Product: 'The curl executable'
selection_opt:
  CommandLine|contains:
    - ' -A '
    - ' --user-agent '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\curl.exe" OR Product="The curl executable" CommandLine IN ("* -A *", "* --user-agent *")
